A particle of mass 8 kg is projected with a speed of 5 m s up a line of greatest slope of a rough plane
inclined at an angle ! to the horizontal, where sin ! = . The motion of the particle is resisted by a
constant frictional force of magnitude 15 N. The particle comes to instantaneous rest after travelling
a distance x m up the plane.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate, in kW, the power developed by the engine of the car.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Given that this power is suddenly decreased by 22 kW, find the instantaneous deceleration
of the car.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
The car now travels at constant speed up a straight road inclined at 8Å to the horizontal, with the
engine working at 80 kW. Assuming the resistance force remains the same, find this constant
speed.

A particle A of mass 1.6 kg rests on a horizontal table and is attached to one end of a light inextensible
string. The string passes over a small smooth pulley P fixed at the edge of the table. The other end of
the string is attached to a particle B of mass 2.4 kg which hangs freely below the pulley. The system
is released from rest with the string taut and with B at a height of 0.5 m above the ground, as shown
in the diagram. In the subsequent motion A does not reach P before B reaches the ground.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Given that the table is smooth, find the time taken by B to reach the ground.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Given instead that the table is rough and that the coefficient of friction between A and the table is
, find the total distance travelled by A. You may assume that A does not reach the pulley.
